# Workbooks

> Workbooks is a software ecosystem where people and AI build together — and what
> they build runs anywhere, stays connected, and keeps getting better. The core
> unit is a workbook: a single HTML file that carries a whole piece of software
> (interface, code, data, history) and opens anywhere a browser does. The Nexus
> is the engine you own that runs workbooks (laptop or cloud) and makes them
> isolated, stateful, and agentic. Toolkits are real programs compiled to
> WebAssembly wrapped in readable manuals that teach people and agents alike.

The CLI is `wbx` (installed via https://workbooks.sh/install.sh). With a coding
agent, install the skills: `npx skills add workbooks-sh/workbooks.sh`.

## Learn
The Learning Center teaches Workbooks from zero — plain-language lessons, no
technical background needed. Full index: https://workbooks.sh/learn/llms.txt
- [Why Workbooks](https://workbooks.sh/learn/why-workbooks): The problem/solution case for the ecosystem across people, teams, and organizations — and why this is the durable, future-proof shape, framed indirectly around the shift to directing software rather than hand-building it
- [Why you can build software now](https://workbooks.sh/learn/why-you-can-build-now): The job-to-be-done framing: you don't want 'a workbook', you want software shipped
- [Telling your agent what you want](https://workbooks.sh/learn/tell-it-what-you-want): Level 1->2 of the maturity ladder: describe the outcome, not the implementation; give complete, consistent context; specificity is the single biggest factor in output quality
- [The loop: prompt, look, redirect](https://workbooks.sh/learn/the-loop-prompt-look-redirect): Level 2: iteration is a loop, not one perfect prompt
- [Reading what your agent did](https://workbooks.sh/learn/reading-what-it-did): Level 2->3: review AI work like an untrusted colleague — the sniff-check, spotting drift and failure modes, and the unfakeable ledger as your trustable record
- [Your first workbook, start to finish](https://workbooks.sh/learn/first-workbook-end-to-end): The single worked narrative every analog front-loads and we have zero of: a marketer ships a small tool — prompt -> agent builds -> you review -> ship — told as one continuous story threading the L1->2->3 ladder
- [The file you end up holding](https://workbooks.sh/learn/the-one-file): Reframed from 'Foundations = the file' to 'the core unit of an ecosystem
- [The file that remembers how it was made](https://workbooks.sh/learn/carries-its-story): How one artifact carries its own source, identity, and change history so it explains itself and proves where it came from

## Docs
Reference and guides at https://docs.workbooks.sh — full index:
https://docs.workbooks.sh/llms.txt
- [install](https://docs.workbooks.sh/start/install): Install the wbx CLI and the engine
- [your-first-workbook](https://docs.workbooks.sh/start/your-first-workbook): Direct an agent to build your first workbook
- [what-is-a-toolkit](https://docs.workbooks.sh/concepts/what-is-a-toolkit): What a toolkit is — wasm program + readable manual
- [the-dock](https://docs.workbooks.sh/concepts/the-dock): The Dock & capabilities — the host membrane
- [cli](https://docs.workbooks.sh/reference/cli): wbx CLI — every verb, mode, and flag
- [cloud](https://docs.workbooks.sh/deploy/cloud): Deploy a workbook to the cloud
- [maturity](https://docs.workbooks.sh/maturity): Capability matrix — the honest 'what works?' answer

## Try
- [hello-workbook.html](https://workbooks.sh/learn/hello-workbook.html): a real workbook that explains itself — live WebAssembly inside
- [Source](https://github.com/workbooks-sh/workbooks.sh): Apache-2.0, open forever
